title: M/Y Maravi Makes Debut At Cannes Yachting Festival 2026
description: The 34-metre M/Y Maravi will debut at the Cannes Yachting Festival this September, showcasing Van Der Valk's latest luxury motor yacht design.
html:
Van Der Valk Shipyard Presents 34-Metre Motor Yacht In September

Van Der Valk Shipyard is preparing to unveil the 34-metre M/Y Maravi at the Cannes Yachting Festival this September, marking a significant presentation for the Dutch builder's latest offering in the charter and luxury market. The vessel will be displayed across the festival's dual venues—the historic Vieux Port and the modern Port Canto—both situated in the picturesque Bay of Cannes. This strategic location provides potential charterers and buyers with an ideal setting to experience the yacht's design and capabilities firsthand.

The M/Y Maravi represents Van Der Valk's commitment to building vessels for discerning owners who demand both performance and refined aesthetics. At 34 metres in length, the motor yacht sits within the sweet spot for charter operations and private ownership, offering sufficient space for entertaining and cruising while maintaining operational efficiency. The vessel's modern lines and contemporary interior design reflect current market preferences among affluent yacht enthusiasts aged 60 and above, a demographic increasingly drawn to newer builds with advanced technology and comfort features.

The Cannes presentation comes at a pivotal moment for the superyacht charter market, where demand for well-appointed vessels in the 30-to-40-metre range continues to strengthen. The M/Y Maravi's debut will allow prospective charterers to evaluate the yacht's layout, guest accommodations, and onboard systems. The vessel's positioning at Cannes—one of the world's most prestigious yachting destinations—underscores Van Der Valk's confidence in the design and its market appeal.

The festival itself draws international yacht brokers, charter operators, and high-net-worth individuals seeking to explore the latest innovations in maritime luxury. For FYI Yachts and similar brokerage firms specializing in newer vessels and charter opportunities, events like Cannes provide essential networking and client engagement opportunities. The M/Y Maravi's presence will likely generate considerable interest among those seeking modern, well-maintained motor yachts suitable for Mediterranean and beyond cruising.

Van Der Valk's reputation for quality construction and attention to detail has made the shipyard a preferred choice for owners and charter companies alike. The M/Y Maravi continues this tradition, combining Dutch engineering excellence with contemporary design sensibilities. Prospective charterers and buyers interested in viewing the M/Y Maravi at the Cannes Yachting Festival are encouraged to contact FYI Yachts to arrange a private showing or to discuss charter availability and ownership opportunities for this exceptional vessel.
